terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
Welcome to Pathway (the "Platform"). By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to these terms.

1. Services
The Platform provides career exploration, AI-assisted assessment, and human coaching bookings. AI-generated content is for reference only and does not constitute career, legal, or financial advice.

2. Accounts
You must register with a valid, accurate email address and are responsible for all activity under your account. Keep your password secure and contact us immediately if you notice unauthorized use. Multiple accounts created to circumvent limits are not permitted.

3. Coaches and bookings
Coaches must submit genuine identity and credential documents and pass Platform review before being listed. The Platform does not guarantee specific outcomes from coaching, but will help resolve booking disputes. Learners should confirm time and price before booking.

4. Payments
The Platform collects session fees via Stripe. A booking becomes effective after payment succeeds and the coach confirms it. The Platform settles earnings with coaches at the agreed rate after receiving payment.

5. Cancellations and refunds
Refund rules are set out in the Refund Policy.

6. Acceptable use
You may not post unlawful, infringing, discriminatory, harassing, or false content, or bypass Platform payments or transact privately. We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules.

7. Intellectual property
Platform content (other than user-uploaded content) belongs to the Platform. Resumes and documents you upload are used solely to provide the service, and you retain ownership of them.

8. Limitation of liability
To the extent permitted by law, the Platform is not liable for indirect losses arising from use of the service.

9. Changes
We may update these terms and will notify you of material changes via the site or email. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

10. Contact
For questions, reach us through in-product support or the email address on your account.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
We take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how Pathway collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

1. Information we collect
- Account: name, email, and password (securely stored by Firebase Authentication).
- Profile: current role, target direction, skills, interests, and assessment answers.
- Resumes and documents: files you upload and the text extracted from them.
- Transaction data: orders, bookings, and payment status. We do not store full card details; payments are processed by Stripe.

2. How we use it
To provide career assessments, recommend paths, match coaches, process bookings and payments, improve the product, and keep the Platform secure.

3. AI processing
Your profile and resume text are sent to AI models to generate reports and coach replies. We do not use your personal information to train public third-party models.

4. Sharing
We share information only: with your chosen coach as needed to deliver the booking (never the raw resume); with Stripe to process payments; or as required by law.

5. Storage and security
Data is stored on Google Cloud (Firebase) with access controls and encrypted transport. We retain data as needed for the service and as required by law.

6. Your rights
You can view, edit, or delete your profile and resumes at any time and request account deletion. After deletion, data is removed from production (backups are purged on a rolling schedule).

7. Cookies
We use essential local storage to keep you signed in and remember preferences. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.

8. Contact
To exercise these rights or ask privacy questions, contact us from your registered email.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.body:
To protect both learners and coaches, the following refund rules apply.

1. Coach has not confirmed
If the coach does not confirm before the session or declines the booking, you receive a full refund and the slot is released automatically.

2. Learner cancellation
- More than 24 hours before a confirmed session: full refund.
- Within 24 hours of the session: no refund; you may ask the coach to reschedule.
- Bookings not yet confirmed by the coach: cancel anytime for a full refund.

3. No-shows
If the learner does not attend without notice, the session is treated as completed and is non-refundable. If the coach does not attend, you receive a full refund plus a Platform credit.

4. Quality disputes
If you're unhappy with a session, submit details within 7 days. We will review within 5 business days and issue a partial or full refund where warranted.

5. Packages
5-session packages are redeemed per session. Used sessions are non-refundable; unused sessions may be refunded pro rata within 90 days of purchase.

6. Refund timing
Refunds are returned via Stripe to the original payment method, typically within 5–10 business days depending on your card issuer.

7. Disputed transactions
If you notice a duplicate or unauthorized charge, contact us immediately and we'll prioritize the case.
